graded_integer_vector: F=(F_H,F_V,F_V_INV), exact source-support count vector by current ingress phase
magnitude_collapse: if continuation occurs, arbitrary huge M maps to unit outgoing phase support in one collision; M magnitude is not carried as a propagation budget
method: exact symbolic transfer only; no M-object or history enumeration
residue_partition: ABSENT in the positive phase family; lambda acts on phase code, not M residues
scale_down: all M>=1 have the same transfer class for fixed (p,lambda); decreasing M creates no threshold until the degenerate M=0 no-front state
stress_class: single-phase huge states F=M*e_p with p in {0,1,2}; this preserves within-phase permutation symmetry and tests magnitude sensitivity
transfer_theorem: For every M>=1 on a single phase p, all M indistinguishable incoming lineages take the same terminal action. Resident continuation depends only on p+lambda=0. Therefore F'=ZERO on a stop hit and F'=e_(p+1 mod3) otherwise.
